head: kšy (< MEA kšy to pile up, heap CSD 228)

examples.turoyo: bi=šato du=Sayfo laḥ-ḥanfe kšalle kəšyawoṯo d-qṭile Mšiḥoye b-ṭurʕabdin.
examples.translation: In the year of S., the godless heaped up heaps of murdered Christians in Turabdin.
examples.raw: bi=šato du=Sayfo laḥ-ḥanfe kšalle kəšyawoṯo d-qṭile Mšiḥoye b-ṭurʕabdin. In the year of S., the godless heaped up heaps of murdered Christians in Turabdin.

examples.turoyo: bu=payəz an-noše kokošən aq-qayse ʕal ḥḏoḏe (Ilyas July 2020)

examples.turoyo: W i=naqqa d-xayifo d-lo mənqoliwa, saymiwayna hawxa d-əmmat tamo bi=arʕo, čike-ste hawxa d-nəšfi, d-miḥoṣi bə-ḥḏoḏe. ṣira, tarte, tlōṯ w bu=šəklawo, košənwanne bə-ḥḏoḏe
